name: actual_bundled_model_readiness
command:
from gateway.main import Models,create_app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
models=Models()
assert models.ready()
loaded=models.transaction
with TestClient(create_app(models)) as client:
    assert client.get('/readyz').status_code==200
    models.transaction=None
    assert not models.ready()
    assert client.get('/readyz').status_code==503
    assert client.get('/healthz').status_code==200
    models.transaction=loaded
    assert models.ready()
    assert client.get('/readyz').status_code==200
print('actual bundled fitted-model readiness/unload/reload and independent liveness passed')
